name: Ancient Greek

strings.reviewBody: Καιρὸς μελέτης. Ἅψαι ἵνα σεαυτὸν δοκιμάσῃς.

words.exEn: You and I are friends.
And who are you?
We seek the truth.

words.ex: Ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου.
words.exEn: You are the light of the world.
words.exFr: Vous êtes la lumière du monde.

words.exEn: He himself said it.
Who is this man?
That mountain is high.

words.ex: Ὃν οἱ θεοὶ φιλοῦσιν, ἀποθνῄσκει νέος.
words.exEn: He whom the gods love dies young.
words.exFr: Celui que les dieux aiment meurt jeune.

words.exEn: What is truth?
No one errs willingly.
words.exFr: Nul ne fait le mal volontairement.

words.exEn: One man is no man.
words.exFr: Un seul homme n'est pas un homme.

words.exEn: In the beginning was the Word.
I am going into the city.
From small things come great things.
words.exFr: Des petites choses naissent les grandes.

words.exEn: He fell from his horse.
We are walking toward the sea.

words.en: beside, from, at the house of
words.fr: auprès de, de la part de, chez
words.exEn: We are staying beside the river.
words.exFr: Nous restons au bord du fleuve.

words.exEn: I am dining with my friends.
He is sleeping under the tree.
The bread is on the table.
words.exFr: Le pain est sur la table.

words.exEn: We are conversing about the soul.

words.fr: à travers (+ gén.) ; à cause de (+ acc.)
words.exEn: I am walking through the marketplace.

words.en: down from (+ gen.); according to (+ acc.)
words.fr: du haut de (+ gén.) ; selon (+ acc.)
words.exEn: We live according to the law.
With Athena's help, move your hand too.
words.exFr: Avec l'aide d'Athéna, remue aussi la main.

words.fr: pour, en faveur de ; au-dessus de
words.exEn: They fight for their homeland.
You too, my child?
There is need not of words but of deeds.
words.exFr: Il faut des actes, non des paroles.

words.exEn: For the task is difficult.
What then shall we do?
I know that you are a friend.
words.exFr: Je sais que tu es un ami.

words.exEn: If you want to, you can.
How beautiful the rose is!
We learn in order to be wise.

words.en: so that, with the result that
words.fr: de sorte que, si bien que
words.ex: Οὕτω σοφός ἐστιν ὥστε πάντες αὐτὸν θαυμάζουσιν.
words.exEn: He is so wise that everyone admires him.
words.exFr: Il est si sage que tous l'admirent.

words.exEn: Since it was night, they were sleeping.
words.exFr: Comme il faisait nuit, ils dormaient.

words.exEn: When he came, we rejoiced.
words.exFr: Quand il est venu, nous nous sommes réjouis.

words.exEn: Now, or tomorrow?

words.en: on the one hand (paired with δέ)
words.ex: Οἱ μὲν λέγουσιν, οἱ δὲ σιγῶσιν.
words.exEn: Some speak, others are silent.
words.exFr: Les uns parlent, les autres se taisent.

words.en: and, but; on the other hand
words.ex: Ὁ μὲν λέγει, ὁ δὲ ἀκούει.
words.exEn: One speaks, the other listens.
Who would believe this?
Do you love me?
I am not telling a lie.
words.exFr: Je ne dis pas de mensonge.

words.exEn: Do not be afraid.
Yes, I want to.
O friend, greetings!
Alas, what things we suffer!
words.exFr: Hélas, que de maux nous souffrons !

words.exEn: Well done, my boy!
I am a human being.
Become who you are.
I have many friends.
You are making an elephant out of a fly.
words.exFr: Tu fais d'une mouche un éléphant.

words.exEn: Fare well, my friend.
They are working in the field.
Tell me the truth.
What do you say?
The messenger announces the victory.
The student answers clearly.
Socrates is always asking questions.
The beggar asks for bread.
What do they call you?
From seeing comes loving.
Listen much, speak little.
We perceive the light with our eyes.
words.exFr: Nous percevons la lumière par les yeux.

words.exEn: I know one thing: that I know nothing.
words.exFr: Je sais une seule chose : que je ne sais rien.

words.exEn: Know thyself.
I know how to write and read.
Never tire of learning.
Time teaches all things.
The teacher educates the children.
The boy is reading the book.
I am writing a letter to my friend.
words.exFr: J'écris une lettre à mon ami.

words.exEn: I have found it, I have found it!
Seek and you shall find.
I give you a gift.
Come and take them.
Accept the gifts of your friends.
words.exFr: Accepte les cadeaux de tes amis.

words.exEn: You are bringing owls to Athens.
words.exFr: Tu portes des chouettes à Athènes.

words.exEn: The shepherd leads the sheep.
The king sends a messenger.
I came, I saw, I conquered.
words.exFr: Je suis venu, j'ai vu, j'ai vaincu.

words.exEn: We are walking to the temple.
We are arriving at the harbor.
The coward flees the battle.
We pursue virtue.

words.ex: Ὁ παῖς ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ τρέχει.
words.exEn: The boy is running in the street.
Hasten slowly.
We are staying in the house.
When the oak falls, every man gathers wood.
words.exFr: Quand le chêne est tombé, chacun fait du bois.

words.exEn: Let him who is without fault cast the first stone.
words.exFr: Que celui qui est sans faute jette la première pierre.

words.ex: Ὁ στρατιώτης τὴν ἀσπίδα οὐ λείπει.
words.exEn: The soldier does not leave his shield behind.
words.exFr: Le soldat n'abandonne pas son bouclier.

words.ex: Τίθημι τὸ βιβλίον ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης.
words.exEn: I put the book on the table.
words.exFr: Je pose le livre sur la table.

words.ex: Δός μοι ποῦ στῶ, καὶ τὴν γῆν κινήσω.
words.exEn: Give me a place to stand, and I will move the earth.
words.exFr: Donne-moi un point d'appui, et je soulèverai la terre.

words.exEn: Office reveals the man.
Wealth has destroyed many.
words.exFr: La richesse a perdu bien des hommes.

words.exEn: The laws preserve the city.

words.en: to stop, put an end to
words.exEn: Enough of words.
The king rules the land.
Rejoice, we have won!
We are fighting for freedom.

words.ex: Ὁ χρόνος καὶ τὴν λύπην ἀποκτείνει.
words.exEn: Time kills even grief.
words.exFr: Le temps tue même le chagrin.

words.exEn: It is noble to die for one's homeland.
words.exFr: Il est beau de mourir pour la patrie.

words.exEn: While we live, let us live well.
words.exFr: Tant que nous vivons, vivons bien.

words.exEn: I grow old always learning many things.
words.exFr: Je vieillis en apprenant toujours beaucoup.

words.exEn: They live in the village.

words.ex: Ὁ κύων παρὰ τῇ θύρᾳ καθεύδει.
words.exEn: The dog is sleeping by the door.
words.exFr: Le chien dort près de la porte.

words.exEn: The sun wakes people up.
We are sitting in the theater.
Follow the god.
Do not touch the fire.
We are sailing to the island.
We are sacrificing to the gods.
We pray to the gods.
Do not trust everyone.
words.exFr: Ne te fie pas à tout le monde.

words.exEn: I consider you to be wise.
It seems to me to be true.
The general leads the army.
Judge not, that you be not judged.
words.exFr: Ne jugez pas, afin de n'être pas jugés.

words.ex: Ἡ φιλοσοφία ἄρχεται ἐκ τοῦ θαυμάζειν.
words.exEn: Philosophy begins in wonder.
I hope to see you tomorrow.

words.ex: Ὁ σοφὸς τὸν θάνατον οὐ φοβεῖται.
words.exEn: The wise man does not fear death.
words.exFr: Le sage ne craint pas la mort.

words.exEn: Greetings, friends!
The child laughs happily.
I love you.
We are in love with wisdom.
I hate falsehood.
What do you want, my friend?
I want to learn the Greek language.
words.exFr: Je veux apprendre la langue grecque.

words.exEn: I can do this.
There is need of money.
One must keep the laws.

words.fr: être sur le point de, avoir l'intention
words.exEn: I am about to write a letter.
The winter forces us to stay.
The general orders them to fight.
The orator persuades the people.
Learning comes through suffering.

words.ex: Ἐσθίομεν ἵνα ζῶμεν, οὐ ζῶμεν ἵνα ἐσθίωμεν.
words.exEn: We eat to live, we do not live to eat.
words.exFr: Nous mangeons pour vivre, nous ne vivons pas pour manger.

words.exEn: I drink water, and a little wine.
words.exFr: Je bois de l'eau, et un peu de vin.

words.exEn: I am buying bread in the marketplace.
The farmer sells fruit.

words.ex: Τίμα τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα.
words.exEn: Honor your father and your mother.
words.exFr: Honore ton père et ta mère.

words.exEn: Deeds reveal the person.
The sun is appearing again.
Wrong no one.
words.exFr: Ne fais de tort à personne.

words.exEn: Friends help friends.
The dogs guard the house.
Night hides all things.

words.ex: Οἱ ὄρνιθες ἐν τοῖς δένδροις ᾄδουσιν.
words.exEn: The birds are singing in the trees.
words.exFr: Les oiseaux chantent dans les arbres.

words.exEn: Everything flows.
Choose the best life.
To err is human.
Better to be silent than to speak badly.
words.exFr: Mieux vaut se taire que mal parler.

words.exEn: Man is by nature a political animal.
words.exFr: L'homme est par nature un animal politique.

words.exEn: Tell me, Muse, of the man of many turns.
words.exFr: Dis-moi, Muse, l'homme aux mille tours.

words.ex: Ἡ σοφὴ γυνὴ βουλὴν ἀγαθὴν δίδωσιν.
words.exEn: A wise woman gives good counsel.
words.exFr: Une femme sage donne de bons conseils.

words.ex: Οἱ παῖδες ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ παίζουσιν.
words.exEn: The children are playing in the street.
words.exFr: Les enfants jouent dans la rue.

words.exEn: Children love their parents.
The son imitates his father.

words.ex: Ἡ θυγάτηρ τῇ μητρὶ ὁμοία ἐστίν.
words.exEn: The daughter is like her mother.
words.exFr: La fille ressemble à sa mère.

words.exEn: The father rules the household.
The mother loves her daughter.
My brother is a soldier.
My sister sings well.
Listen to the elders.
The young man runs fast.
The maiden is weaving a garland.
words.exFr: La jeune fille tresse une couronne.

words.exEn: A friend is another self.

words.ex: Ὁ πιστὸς ἑταῖρος ἐν τοῖς κινδύνοις γιγνώσκεται.
words.exEn: The faithful companion is known in times of danger.
words.exFr: Le fidèle compagnon se reconnaît dans le danger.

words.exEn: Zeus protects strangers.

words.ex: Οἱ ἐχθροὶ πρὸ τῶν τειχῶν εἰσιν.
words.exEn: The enemies are before the walls.
words.exFr: Les ennemis sont devant les murs.

words.ex: Ὁ ἀγαθὸς πολίτης τοῖς νόμοις πείθεται.
words.exEn: The good citizen obeys the laws.
words.exFr: Le bon citoyen obéit aux lois.

words.exEn: Every slave longs for freedom.
words.exFr: Tout esclave aspire à la liberté.

words.exEn: The master calls the slave.

words.ex: Ὁ ἀγαθὸς βασιλεὺς ὥσπερ πατήρ ἐστιν.
words.exEn: A good king is like a father.
words.exFr: Un bon roi est comme un père.

words.exEn: Insolence breeds the tyrant.
The general arranges his soldiers.
The soldier guards his homeland.

words.ex: Οἱ ναῦται τὴν θάλασσαν οὐ φοβοῦνται.
words.exEn: Sailors do not fear the sea.
words.exFr: Les marins ne craignent pas la mer.

words.exEn: Homer, the best of poets.
The philosopher seeks the truth.
The teacher teaches letters.
The student follows his teacher.
Time is the healer of all things.
The farmer works the land.

words.ex: Ὁ ῥήτωρ ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ λέγει.
words.exEn: The orator speaks in the assembly.
The good judge judges justly.
words.exFr: Le bon juge juge avec justice.

words.ex: Ὁ ἱερεὺς ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ θύει.
words.exEn: The priest sacrifices in the temple.
words.exFr: Le prêtre sacrifie dans le sanctuaire.

words.exEn: Heroes have immortal fame.
words.exFr: Les héros ont une gloire immortelle.

words.exEn: All things are full of gods.

words.ex: Ἡ Ἀθηνᾶ θεὰ τῆς σοφίας ἐστίν.
words.exEn: Athena is the goddess of wisdom.
words.exFr: Athéna est la déesse de la sagesse.

words.exEn: Character is destiny for man.
words.exFr: Le caractère de l'homme est son destin.

words.exEn: The gods send messengers.
Water is best.
words.exFr: L'eau est la meilleure des choses.

words.exEn: The whole earth is the tomb of famous men.
words.exFr: La terre entière est le tombeau des hommes illustres.

words.exEn: The air is clean.
Fire tests gold.
The sea! The sea!

words.ex: Δὶς εἰς τὸν αὐτὸν ποταμὸν οὐκ ἂν ἐμβαίης.
words.exEn: You could not step twice into the same river.
words.exFr: On ne se baigne pas deux fois dans le même fleuve.

words.exEn: The mountains are full of snow.
words.exFr: Les montagnes sont pleines de neige.

words.exEn: Greece has many islands.

words.ex: Ὁρῶ τοὺς ἀστέρας ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ.
words.exEn: I see the stars in the sky.
words.exFr: Je vois les étoiles dans le ciel.

words.exEn: The sun shines for everyone.
The moon lights up the night.

words.ex: Οἱ ἀστέρες τοῖς ναύταις τὴν ὁδὸν δεικνύασιν.
words.exEn: The stars show sailors the way.
words.exFr: Les étoiles montrent la route aux marins.

words.exEn: The wind raises the waves.
A tall tree provides shade.
words.exFr: Un grand arbre donne de l'ombre.

words.ex: Τὰ ἄνθη ἐν τῷ ἔαρι θάλλει.
words.exEn: Flowers bloom in spring.

words.ex: Ῥίζα παιδείας πικρά, καρπὸς δὲ γλυκύς.
words.exEn: The root of education is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
words.exFr: La racine de l'éducation est amère, mais son fruit est doux.

words.exEn: You are boiling a stone (wasting your effort).
words.exFr: Tu fais bouillir une pierre (tu perds ta peine).

words.exEn: Gold persuades many.

words.ex: Ὁ ἄργυρος ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἔρχεται.
words.exEn: Silver comes out of the earth.
Iron sharpens iron.

words.ex: Τὸ φῶς ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ φαίνει.
words.exEn: The light shines in the darkness.
words.exFr: La lumière brille dans les ténèbres.

words.ex: Μετὰ τὸν σκότον ἔρχεται τὸ φῶς.
words.exEn: After darkness comes the light.
Man is the dream of a shadow.
words.exFr: L'homme est le rêve d'une ombre.

words.exEn: Snow covers the mountains.
The earth drinks the rain.
A constant drip hollows out the rock.
words.exFr: La goutte qui persiste creuse le rocher.

words.exEn: From a small spring, a great river.
words.exFr: D'une petite source naît un grand fleuve.

words.ex: Ἐν τῇ λίμνῃ ἰχθύες πολλοί εἰσιν.
words.exEn: There are many fish in the lake.
words.exFr: Il y a beaucoup de poissons dans le lac.

words.exEn: The waves strike the ship.
Wolves live in the forest.
The oxen are in the field.
Roses bloom in the garden.
words.exFr: Des roses fleurissent dans le jardin.

words.exEn: All animals need food.
words.exFr: Tous les animaux ont besoin de nourriture.

words.ex: Ὁ δούρειος ἵππος τὴν Τροίαν εἷλεν.
words.exEn: The wooden horse took Troy.
words.exFr: Le cheval de bois a pris Troie.

words.exEn: An ox sits on my tongue (I must keep silent).
words.exFr: Un bœuf sur la langue (je dois me taire).

words.exEn: The sheep fear the wolf.

words.ex: Αἱ αἶγες ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσι νέμονται.
words.exEn: The goats graze in the mountains.
words.exFr: Les chèvres paissent dans les montagnes.

words.exEn: The dog is the most faithful of animals.
words.exFr: Le chien est le plus fidèle des animaux.

words.exEn: By its claw you know the lion.
words.exFr: À la griffe on reconnaît le lion.

words.exEn: I am holding a wolf by the ears.
words.exFr: Je tiens un loup par les oreilles.

words.exEn: You are seeking hen's milk (the impossible).
An eagle does not hunt flies.
words.exFr: L'aigle ne chasse pas les mouches.

words.ex: Ὁ ὄφις ἐν τῇ πόᾳ κρύπτεται.
words.exEn: The snake hides in the grass.
words.exFr: Le serpent se cache dans l'herbe.

words.ex: Ἰχθὺς ἐκ τῆς κεφαλῆς ὄζειν ἄρχεται.
words.exEn: A fish begins to stink from the head.
words.exFr: Le poisson pourrit par la tête.

words.exEn: The soul moves the body.
The head rules the body.
Eyes are more exact witnesses than ears.
words.exFr: Les yeux sont des témoins plus sûrs que les oreilles.

words.exEn: We hear with our ears.

words.ex: Ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὁ λόγος ἔρχεται.
words.exEn: Speech comes out of the mouth.
words.exFr: La parole sort de la bouche.

words.ex: Ἡ γλῶσσα πολλῶν κακῶν αἰτία ἐστίν.
words.exEn: The tongue is the cause of many evils.
words.exFr: La langue est la cause de bien des maux.

words.exEn: One hand washes the other.
Achilles, swift of foot.

words.ex: Ἡ καρδία ἐν τῷ στήθει πηδᾷ.
words.exEn: The heart leaps in the chest.
words.exFr: Le cœur bondit dans la poitrine.

words.ex: Τὸ αἷμα διὰ τοῦ σώματος ῥεῖ.
words.exEn: Blood flows through the body.
words.exFr: Le sang coule à travers le corps.

words.exEn: The face reveals the soul.
Rosy-fingered Dawn.
A voice crying in the wilderness.
words.exFr: Une voix crie dans le désert.

words.exEn: A library is the healing-place of the soul.
words.exFr: Une bibliothèque est le remède de l'âme.

words.exEn: The mind sees and the mind hears.
words.exFr: C'est l'esprit qui voit et l'esprit qui entend.

words.exEn: Judgment is stronger than strength.
words.exFr: Le jugement est plus fort que la force.

words.exEn: Wisdom is a more precious possession than wealth.
words.exFr: La sagesse est un bien plus précieux que la richesse.

words.exEn: Knowledge is power.

words.ex: Ὁ βίος βραχύς, ἡ δὲ τέχνη μακρή.
words.exEn: Life is short, but art is long.
words.exFr: La vie est courte, mais l'art est long.

words.exEn: A word is the shadow of a deed.
words.exFr: La parole est l'ombre de l'acte.

words.exEn: Stories delight children.
My name is Alexandros.

words.ex: Φίλος μὲν Πλάτων, φιλτέρα δὲ ἀλήθεια.
words.exEn: Plato is a friend, but truth is a dearer friend.
words.exFr: Platon m'est cher, mais la vérité m'est plus chère encore.

words.exEn: A lie has a short life.
words.exFr: Le mensonge a la vie courte.

words.exEn: Opinion is not knowledge.
Memory is the mother of the Muses.
words.exFr: La mémoire est la mère des Muses.

words.exEn: Hope sustains most people.
words.exFr: L'espoir nourrit la plupart des hommes.

words.exEn: Fear is a bad adviser.
Love is blind.

words.ex: Ἡ φιλία τὸν βίον γλυκὺν ποιεῖ.
words.exEn: Friendship makes life sweet.
Victory brings joy.
Time is the healer of grief for men.
words.exFr: Le temps est pour les hommes le médecin du chagrin.

words.exEn: Master your anger.

words.ex: Ἡ ἡδονὴ βραχεῖα, ἡ δὲ ἀρετὴ ἀθάνατος.
words.exEn: Pleasure is brief, but virtue is immortal.
words.exFr: Le plaisir est bref, mais la vertu est immortelle.

words.exEn: Is virtue teachable?
Justice is the foundation of the city.
words.exFr: La justice est le fondement de la cité.

words.exEn: Self-control is the greatest virtue.
words.exFr: La modération est la plus grande vertu.

words.exEn: Ruin follows insolence.
Modesty adorns the young.
Honor is the prize of virtue.
words.exFr: L'honneur est le prix de la vertu.

words.exEn: Imperishable fame.
We seek the causes of things.
words.exFr: Nous cherchons les causes des choses.

words.exEn: Bad company corrupts good character.
words.exFr: Les mauvaises compagnies corrompent les bonnes mœurs.

words.exEn: No one escapes fate.
Fortune changes quickly.
Even the gods do not fight against necessity.
words.exFr: Contre la nécessité, même les dieux ne luttent pas.

words.exEn: Happiness is the goal of life.
words.exFr: Le bonheur est le but de la vie.

words.exEn: Freedom is more precious than gold.
words.exFr: La liberté est plus précieuse que l'or.

words.ex: Ἡ παιδεία εὐτυχοῦσι κόσμος, ἀτυχοῦσι δὲ καταφύγιον.
words.exEn: Education is an ornament in prosperity, a refuge in adversity.
words.exFr: L'éducation est une parure dans la prospérité, un refuge dans le malheur.

words.exEn: Nature does nothing in vain.
words.exFr: La nature ne fait rien en vain.

words.exEn: For it is men who are the city.
words.exFr: Car ce sont les hommes qui font la cité.

words.exEn: Everything is sold in the marketplace.
My house is small.
A home that is dear is the best home.
words.exFr: Rien ne vaut son propre foyer.

words.ex: Ἐν ταῖς Ἀθήναις ὁ δῆμος κρατεῖ.
words.exEn: In Athens the people rule.

words.ex: Ἡ βουλὴ περὶ τοῦ πολέμου βουλεύεται.
words.exEn: The council deliberates about the war.
words.exFr: Le conseil délibère sur la guerre.

words.ex: Οἱ πολῖται εἰς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν συνέρχονται.
words.exEn: The citizens gather for the assembly.
words.exFr: Les citoyens se réunissent en assemblée.

words.exEn: Law is the king of all.
words.exFr: La loi est reine de toutes choses.

words.ex: Ἡ δίκη ὀψὲ ἔρχεται, ἀλλ' ἔρχεται.
words.exEn: Justice comes late, but it comes.
words.exFr: La justice vient tard, mais elle vient.

words.ex: Πᾶσα ἡ πόλις εἰς τὸ θέατρον ἔρχεται.
words.exEn: The whole city goes to the theater.
words.exFr: Toute la cité va au théâtre.

words.ex: Ἐκ τῆς σχολῆς ἡ σοφία γίγνεται.
words.exEn: From leisure comes wisdom.

words.ex: Ἐν τῷ συμποσίῳ πίνομεν καὶ λέγομεν.
words.exEn: At the symposium we drink and talk.
words.exFr: Au banquet, nous buvons et discutons.

words.exEn: Tomorrow is the goddess's festival.
words.exFr: Demain, c'est la fête de la déesse.

words.ex: Μετὰ τὴν θυσίαν ἡ ἑορτὴ ἄρχεται.
words.exEn: After the sacrifice, the festival begins.
words.exFr: Après le sacrifice commence la fête.

words.ex: Τὸ ἱερὸν ἐπὶ τῆς ἀκροπόλεώς ἐστιν.
words.exEn: The temple is on the acropolis.
A fire burns on the altar.
A wooden wall (the oracle meant the ships).
words.exFr: Un rempart de bois (l'oracle désignait les navires).

words.ex: Αἱ πύλαι τῆς πόλεως νυκτὸς κλείονται.
words.exEn: The city gates are closed at night.
words.exFr: Les portes de la ville sont fermées la nuit.

words.exEn: The way up and the way down are one.
words.exFr: Le chemin qui monte et celui qui descend sont un seul et même chemin.

words.exEn: Who is knocking at the door?
We are sitting around the table.
words.exFr: Nous sommes assis autour de la table.

words.ex: Ἡ κώμη παρὰ τὸν ποταμόν ἐστιν.
words.exEn: The village is by the river.
words.exFr: Le village est au bord du fleuve.

words.ex: Αἱ νῆες ἐν τῷ λιμένι ὁρμοῦσιν.
words.exEn: The ships lie at anchor in the harbor.
words.exFr: Les navires mouillent dans le port.

words.exEn: Nothing is sweeter than one's homeland.
words.exFr: Rien n'est plus doux que sa patrie.

words.exEn: War is the father of all things.
words.exFr: La guerre est le père de toutes choses.

words.ex: Πρὸ τῆς μάχης οἱ στρατιῶται εὔχονται.
words.exEn: Before the battle, the soldiers pray.
words.exFr: Avant la bataille, les soldats prient.

words.ex: Ὁ στρατὸς διὰ τῶν ὀρῶν πορεύεται.
words.exEn: The army marches through the mountains.
words.exFr: L'armée marche à travers les montagnes.

words.exEn: The hoplites carry their arms.
The sword is sharp.
They fight with spear and shield.
words.exFr: Ils combattent avec la lance et le bouclier.

words.exEn: Come back with your shield, or on it.
words.exFr: Reviens avec ton bouclier, ou dessus.

words.exEn: Apollo has a silver bow.
With their ships the Greeks won.
words.exFr: C'est par leurs navires que les Grecs ont vaincu.

words.exEn: A Cadmean victory (won at ruinous cost).
words.exFr: Une victoire cadméenne (au prix de la ruine).

words.exEn: Without danger nothing great comes to be.
words.exFr: Sans danger, rien de grand ne se fait.

words.exEn: Death is common to all human beings.
words.exFr: La mort est commune à tous les hommes.

words.exEn: Nothing won by force is secure.
words.exFr: Rien de ce qui est pris par la force n'est durable.

words.ex: Τὸ τοῦ δήμου κράτος δημοκρατία καλεῖται.
words.exEn: The power of the people is called democracy.
words.exFr: Le pouvoir du peuple s'appelle démocratie.

words.exEn: Peace nourishes the arts.
Use time sparingly.
Know the right moment.
Each day is a gift.
In the night, counsel (sleep on it).
In the evening the stars appear.
It is already time to leave.
words.exFr: Il est déjà l'heure de partir.

words.exEn: For many years! (a blessing)
words.exFr: Pour de longues années ! (vœu de bonheur)

words.exEn: The month has thirty days.

words.ex: Ἐν τῷ θέρει ἡ γῆ καρποὺς φέρει.
words.exEn: In summer the earth bears fruit.
words.exFr: En été, la terre porte ses fruits.

words.ex: Μετὰ τὸν χειμῶνα τὸ ἔαρ ἔρχεται.
words.exEn: After winter comes spring.
One swallow does not make a spring.
words.exFr: Une hirondelle ne fait pas le printemps.

words.ex: Ὁ ἀνεξέταστος βίος οὐ βιωτὸς ἀνθρώπῳ.
words.exEn: The unexamined life is not worth living for a human being.
words.exFr: Une vie sans examen ne vaut pas d'être vécue.

words.exEn: Life is short, but sweet.
words.exFr: La vie est brève, mais douce.

words.ex: Σῖτος καὶ ὕδωρ ἀναγκαῖα τῷ βίῳ.
words.exEn: Grain and water are necessary for life.
words.exFr: Le blé et l'eau sont nécessaires à la vie.

words.ex: Οὐκ ἐπ' ἄρτῳ μόνῳ ζήσεται ἄνθρωπος.
words.exEn: Man shall not live by bread alone.
words.exFr: L'homme ne vivra pas de pain seulement.

words.exEn: In wine there is truth.
The baby drinks milk.
His voice flowed sweeter than honey.
words.exFr: Sa voix coulait plus douce que le miel.

words.exEn: You are pouring oil on the fire.
words.exFr: Tu verses de l'huile sur le feu.

words.exEn: The olive tree is Athena's gift.
The shepherd makes cheese.
At the festival we eat meat.
words.exFr: Pendant la fête, nous mangeons de la viande.

words.exEn: I invite you to dinner.
In winter we wear a thick cloak.
words.exFr: En hiver, nous portons un manteau épais.

words.exEn: The tunic is white.

words.ex: Τὸ βιβλίον ὥσπερ φίλος πιστός ἐστιν.
words.exEn: A book is like a faithful friend.
words.exFr: Un livre est comme un ami fidèle.

words.ex: Τὰ γράμματα μένει, οἱ δὲ λόγοι πέτονται.
words.exEn: Writings remain, spoken words fly away.
words.exFr: Les écrits restent, les paroles s'envolent.

words.exEn: I receive a letter from my friend.
words.exFr: Je reçois une lettre de mon ami.

words.ex: Φοβοῦ τοὺς Δαναοὺς καὶ δῶρα φέροντας.
words.exEn: Beware of Greeks even bearing gifts.
words.exFr: Crains les Grecs, même porteurs de présents.

words.exEn: I have money in my purse.
words.exFr: J'ai de l'argent dans ma bourse.

words.exEn: The worker is worthy of his wage.
A possession for all time.
Work is no disgrace.
words.exFr: Le travail n'est pas une honte.

words.ex: Τῶν πόνων πωλοῦσιν ἡμῖν πάντα τἀγαθὰ οἱ θεοί.
words.exEn: The gods sell us all good things at the price of toil.
words.exFr: Les dieux nous vendent tous les biens au prix de la peine.

words.exEn: The matter speaks for itself.
Our country is beautiful.
This place is sacred.

words.ex: Ὁ κόσμος σκηνή, ὁ βίος πάροδος.
words.exEn: The world is a stage, life is a passing entrance.
words.exFr: Le monde est une scène, la vie un passage.

words.exEn: The human race is one.
Plato speaks about the Forms.
Great is the power of truth.
words.exFr: Grande est la puissance de la vérité.

words.ex: Τρόπος ἐστὶν ὁ πείθων, οὐ λόγος.
words.exEn: It is character that persuades, not speech.
words.exFr: C'est le caractère qui persuade, non le discours.

words.exEn: Each person is a part of the city.
words.exFr: Chacun est une partie de la cité.

words.ex: Τὸ πλῆθος ἐν τῇ ἀγορᾷ συλλέγεται.
words.exEn: The crowd gathers in the marketplace.
words.exFr: La foule se rassemble sur l'agora.

words.exEn: All is number.
Man is the measure of all things.
words.exFr: L'homme est la mesure de toutes choses.

words.ex: Ὁ πλοῦτος ἄνευ ἀρετῆς οὐδὲν ὠφελεῖ.
words.exEn: Wealth without virtue is of no benefit.
words.exFr: La richesse sans la vertu ne sert à rien.

words.exEn: Poverty awakens the arts.

words.ex: Ἡ νόσος τὸ σῶμα ἀσθενὲς ποιεῖ.
words.exEn: Disease makes the body weak.
Speech is a remedy for grief.
words.exFr: La parole est un remède au chagrin.

words.exEn: Health is the greatest of goods.
words.exFr: La santé est le plus grand des biens.

words.exEn: She has tears in her eyes.
words.exFr: Elle a des larmes dans les yeux.

words.exEn: Unquenchable laughter among the gods.
words.exFr: Un rire inextinguible chez les dieux.

words.exEn: You are singing a beautiful song.
Music educates the soul.

words.ex: Ὁ χορὸς ἐν τῷ θεάτρῳ ᾄδει.
words.exEn: The chorus sings in the theater.
The contest admits no excuses.
The beginning is half of the whole.
words.exFr: Commencer, c'est déjà la moitié du tout.

words.exEn: Look to the end of life.
words.exFr: Regarde la fin de la vie.

words.exEn: Sing, goddess, the wrath.
Kindness gives birth to kindness.
words.exFr: Une grâce en engendre une autre.

words.exEn: A gentleman, beautiful and good.
words.exFr: Un homme accompli, beau et bon.

words.exEn: From a bad crow, a bad egg.
words.exFr: D'un mauvais corbeau, un mauvais œuf.

words.exEn: Beautiful things are difficult.
Lying is shameful.
Big book, big evil.
From a small seed, a great tree.
words.exFr: D'une petite graine, un grand arbre.

words.ex: Πολλαὶ χεῖρες τὸ ἔργον ἐλαφρὸν ποιοῦσιν.
words.exEn: Many hands make the work light.
words.exFr: Beaucoup de mains rendent le travail léger.

words.ex: Πολλοὶ μὲν κλητοί, ὀλίγοι δὲ ἐκλεκτοί.
words.exEn: Many are called, but few are chosen.
Practice is everything.
The wise man is never alone.
Different people say different things.
The young learn quickly.

words.ex: Ὁ παλαιὸς οἶνος ἡδίων τοῦ νέου.
words.exEn: Old wine is sweeter than new.
words.exFr: Le vin vieux est plus doux que le nouveau.

words.exEn: To a wise man every land is open.
words.exFr: Pour l'homme sage, toute terre est praticable.

words.ex: Δίκαιος ἴσθι καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἐχθρούς.
words.exEn: Be just even toward your enemies.
words.exFr: Sois juste même envers tes ennemis.

words.exEn: What you say is true.
Necessity is strongest, for it rules everything.
words.exFr: La nécessité est la plus forte, car elle commande à tout.

words.exEn: The old man is weak, but wise.
words.exFr: Le vieillard est faible, mais sage.

words.ex: Ὁ ἵππος ταχύς, ἡ δὲ χελώνη βραδεῖα.
words.exEn: The horse is fast, but the tortoise is slow.
words.exFr: Le cheval est rapide, mais la tortue est lente.

words.exEn: The tortoise, though slow, won.
words.exFr: La tortue, bien que lente, a gagné.

words.ex: Ῥᾴδιον τὸ λέγειν, χαλεπὸν δὲ τὸ ποιεῖν.
words.exEn: Saying is easy, doing is hard.
words.exFr: Dire est facile, faire est difficile.

words.exEn: It is difficult to know oneself.
words.exFr: Il est difficile de se connaître soi-même.

words.exEn: Learning is the sweetest thing for human beings.
words.exFr: Apprendre est pour les hommes la chose la plus douce.

words.exEn: War is sweet to those who have never tried it.
words.exFr: La guerre est douce pour qui ne l'a pas connue.

words.exEn: Truth is bitter to many.
words.exFr: La vérité est amère pour beaucoup.

words.exEn: The eagle's eye is sharp.
The road to wisdom is long.
words.exFr: Longue est la route vers la sagesse.

words.exEn: He says much in few words.
words.exFr: Il dit beaucoup en peu de mots.

words.exEn: Lightning strikes the heights.
The wise man is always rich.

words.ex: Ὁ πένης οὐδὲν φοβεῖται· οὐδὲν γὰρ ἔχει.
words.exEn: The poor man fears nothing, for he has nothing.
words.exFr: Le pauvre ne craint rien, car il n'a rien.

words.exEn: The free man has the right to speak openly.
words.exFr: L'homme libre a le droit de parler franchement.

words.exEn: What belongs to friends is held in common.

words.ex: Ὁ τὰ ἴδια μόνον σκοπῶν ἰδιώτης.
words.exEn: He who looks only to his own affairs is an idiotes.
words.exFr: Celui qui ne regarde que ses affaires privées est un idiotès.

words.ex: Πολλὰ τὰ δεινά, κοὐδὲν ἀνθρώπου δεινότερον.
words.exEn: Many things are wondrous, and none more wondrous than man.
words.exFr: Il est bien des merveilles, mais rien n'est plus prodigieux que l'homme.

words.exEn: Being mortal, think mortal thoughts.
words.exFr: Étant mortel, aie des pensées de mortel.

words.exEn: The soul is immortal.
This is clear to everyone.
Each one does his own work.
A good friend is worth much.
The strong do what they can.
words.exFr: Les puissants font ce qu'ils peuvent.

words.exEn: Snow is white.
The black earth gives fruit.
words.exFr: La terre noire donne ses fruits.

words.ex: Καθαρὸν ὕδωρ ἐκ τῆς πηγῆς ῥεῖ.
words.exEn: Pure water flows from the spring.
words.exFr: Une eau pure coule de la source.

words.exEn: The marketplace is full of people.

words.ex: Κενὸς ὁ λόγος ὃς οὐδὲν θεραπεύει.
words.exEn: Empty is the argument that heals nothing.
words.exFr: Vide est le discours qui ne guérit rien.

words.ex: Ὁ πρῶτος ἐν τῷ ἀγῶνι στέφανον λαμβάνει.
words.exEn: The first in the contest receives a crown.
words.exFr: Le premier du concours reçoit une couronne.

words.exEn: Like always draws near to like.

words.ex: Εἷς οἰωνὸς ἄριστος, ἀμύνεσθαι περὶ πάτρης.
words.exEn: One omen is best: to fight for one's country.
words.exFr: Un seul présage est le meilleur : combattre pour sa patrie.

words.ex: Μηδένα πρὸ τοῦ τέλους εὐδαίμονα κάλει.
words.exEn: Call no one happy before the end.
words.exFr: Ne dis personne heureux avant la fin.

words.ex: Ὅμηρος τυφλὸς ἦν, ἀλλὰ πάντα ἑώρα.
words.exEn: Homer was blind, but he saw everything.
words.exFr: Homère était aveugle, mais il voyait tout.

words.exEn: The temperate man rules his pleasures.

words.ex: Ὁ ἀνδρεῖος τοὺς κινδύνους οὐ φοβεῖται.
words.exEn: The brave man does not fear dangers.
words.exFr: L'homme courageux ne craint pas les dangers.

words.exEn: The coward dies many times.
Now is the moment.

words.ex: Τότε νέος ἦν, νῦν δὲ γέρων.
words.exEn: Then I was young, now I am old.
words.exFr: Alors j'étais jeune, maintenant je suis vieux.

words.exEn: God is always doing geometry.
words.exFr: Dieu fait toujours de la géométrie.

words.exEn: Truth never dies.
You often ask the same thing.
words.exFr: Tu demandes souvent la même chose.

words.exEn: Again and again we learn.
It is already evening.
Wait a little longer.
I am coming right away.
Time flees quickly.

words.ex: Οὐ τὸ ζῆν, ἀλλὰ τὸ εὖ ζῆν.
words.exEn: Not living, but living well.
words.exFr: Non pas vivre, mais bien vivre.

words.exEn: The liar has a bad reputation.
Well said.
It is very well.

words.ex: Μᾶλλον φιλῶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἢ τὴν δόξαν.
words.exEn: I love truth more than opinion.
words.exFr: J'aime la vérité plus que l'opinion.

words.exEn: Above all I honor wisdom.
So the matter stands.
I live here.

words.ex: Ἐκεῖ ἡ ἀγορά, ἐνθάδε τὸ ἱερόν.
words.exEn: There is the marketplace, here is the temple.
Where on earth am I?
How are you?
When will our friend arrive?

words.ex: Ἡ κώμη ἐγγὺς τῆς θαλάσσης ἐστίν.
words.exEn: The village is near the sea.
words.exFr: Le village est près de la mer.

words.exEn: He lives far from the city.
words.exFr: Il habite loin de la ville.

words.exEn: The rivers flow backwards (the world is upside down).
words.exFr: Les fleuves remontent vers leurs sources (le monde à l'envers).

words.exEn: Everything is turned upside down.
Today I am learning a new word.
Tomorrow will be better.

words.ex: Χθὲς ὗεν, σήμερον δὲ λάμπει ὁ ἥλιος.
words.exEn: Yesterday it rained, today the sun is shining.
words.exFr: Hier il pleuvait, aujourd'hui le soleil brille.

words.ex: Οἴκοι μένειν δεῖ τὸν καλῶς εὐδαίμονα.
words.exEn: He who would be truly happy should stay at home.
words.exFr: Qui veut être vraiment heureux doit rester chez soi.

words.exEn: Perhaps tomorrow we shall know.

words.ex: Οἱ ἀγροὶ ἔξω τῶν τειχῶν εἰσιν.
words.exEn: The fields are outside the walls.
words.exFr: Les champs sont hors des murs.

words.exEn: The master is inside.
Nothing in excess.
